The '''Neka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Neka was mentioned in cut content for the video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. Its existence was later [[canon]]ized by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
